description:
Another estate sale haul… and this one was GOOD. 🤎

There’s nothing quite like opening up boxes of estate sale finds and discovering all the little treasures tucked inside. Vintage pieces with age, character and stories that make me wonder where they’ve been before finding their way to me. 🥹

And yes… apparently we’re finding vintage Santas in September. 😂🎅🏼

This is only Part 1 because there was way too much goodness to squeeze into one video.

Tell me — what would you have grabbed first?! 👇🏼

Part 2 coming next… and I saved some really good ones. 👀🤎
